proof_summary: Letting \(p=16843\), a finite recurrence modulo \(p^3\) shows that the unreduced numerator of \(H_{p-1}\) is divisible by \(p^3\), hence \(v_p(H_{p-1})\ge3\). Splitting \(H_{p^2-2}\) into terms with denominators divisible by \(p\) and those without, and pairing the latter via \(k\leftrightarrow p^2-k\), gives \(v_p(H_{p^2-2}-1)\ge2\); thus the composite \(p^2\) divides the relevant numerator-minus-denominator.
